title: Life in the Future
text:
In the future, cars will drive by themselves. People will not need to hold the steering wheel. Robots will also help us at home. They can clean the floor and cook simple meals. Many people think this technology will make life easier.

Doctors will also use new machines. A small robot can look inside the body and find sickness early. Computers will help teachers too. Students can learn with fun programs on a tablet. Some people are worried about privacy, but scientists are working on safe systems.

questions.text: What will cars do in the future?
options: They will fly over the city.
They will stop working at night.
They will be made of wood.

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can a small robot do?
options: It can look inside the body and find sickness early.
It can drive cars on the road.
It can cook dinner for students.
It can write letters for teachers.

questions.text: Why are some people worried about future technology?
options: They think their personal information may not be safe.
They do not like robots at all.
They do not have enough money to buy cars.
They want cars to stop moving.

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Future technology may make daily life and health care easier.
Robots will replace all teachers and doctors.
Cars will become too expensive for everyone.

vocabulary.definition: the right to keep personal information private

paragraph_translations: No futuro, os carros vão dirigir sozinhos. As pessoas não vão precisar segurar o volante. Robôs também vão nos ajudar em casa. Eles podem limpar o chão e cozinhar refeições simples. Muitas pessoas acham que essa tecnologia vai tornar a vida mais fácil.

Os médicos também vão usar máquinas novas. Um pequeno robô pode olhar dentro do corpo e encontrar doenças cedo. Os computadores vão ajudar os professores também. Os alunos podem aprender com programas divertidos em um tablet. Algumas pessoas estão preocupadas com a privacidade, mas os cientistas estão trabalhando em sistemas seguros.
